meta.name: frostmere_haven
meta.prompt: An ice-fishing town on a frozen lake in the taiga: huts out on the ice around their fishing holes, sleds and skis by the doors, and a timber church with a bell tower on the shore.

programs.brief: A heavy timber fish-weighing and ice-harvesting staging dock resting on the lake ice, with log hoist frames, iron chains, salted fish barrels, stacked sleds, and cut ice chutes.

A weathered wooden ice-fishing shanty resting on timber runners over the lake ice, with a smoking stovepipe, a cut fishing hole inside the floor, lanterns, and wooden skis and sleds leaning against the outside wall.
A tall timber A-frame drying rack hung with rows of cured winter fish, with sledges, ice augers, and salt crates resting in the snow at its base.

tokens.terrain: a large frozen lake bordered by snowy taiga spruce forest, with the village lining the shore and extending onto the ice
tokens.icons: a prominent timber stave church with a bell tower standing on the frozen shore; clusters of wooden ice-fishing shanties and huts positioned directly on the lake ice around cut fishing holes; sleds, skis, fire braziers, and drying racks beside the cabin doors
